text:
kim: heads-up — during the lunch spike 12:10-12:25 we had ~30 leads linger in HS enrichment and RR never assigned them. noticed a cluster of 429s and a few timeouts.

omar: digging in. enrichment service retried aggressively and exhausted claim retries, then failed quietly. RR logic treats "no owner" as terminal if enrichment is pending.

nina: proposal: change handoff flow so that partial enrichment (email + name present) is eligible for RR assignment. tag lead with `needs-enrich` so SF sync can pick up missing fields async. avoids dropping leads that are assignment-ready.

kim: also add a soft-fallback: if a lead is stuck > 8m or has >4 consecutive enrichment retries, route to `marketing-temporary` owner and mark with `overflow_test_v2`. keeps SDR queue warm.

omar: config snippet for canary: 
```
partial_enrich_ok: true
stuck_threshold_minutes: 8
consecutive_retries_before_overflow: 4
overflow_owner: "marketing-temporary@redwood.com"
assign_tag: "overflow_test_v2"
```

ops-bot: I can wire an alert: `stuck_leads > 5 for 10m` -> post in #marketing. want that?

nina: yes please. also add a counter to differentiate `partial_ok_assigned` vs `overflow_assigned` for downstream analytics. we want to measure conversion delta.

kim: test plan: 30m canary in eu-west, simulate HubSpot 429s and partial enrichment responses, validate RR assigns with tags and SF sync picks up missing fields within 1h.

omar: I'll open PR and include a smoke test that fakes HS responses. will ping @devex for runbook text. PR link when ready.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled by omar — job #5012.

sales-ops: FYI @sales: temporary overflow routing may surface leads to marketing-temporary; they'll be tagged for easy filtering.

kim: if canary stable for 45m, roll to prod low-traffic window. thanks team.

omar: PR: github.com/redwood/leadflow/pull/1892
